_doc: One common, one rare and one epic gift per table, and two legendaries. Animals point at a table in animals.json ('table'), so animals of a kind share one (every dog brings dog gifts). 'animal' on a table is the one shown for it (on its achievement, say). Only legendary gifts are wearable (cosmetics): 'slot' says where, 'style' how the placeholder drawing shows it and 'colour' its colour (else the rarity's gold). The wearable slots each have the same number of cosmetics (hat, neckwear, top, gloves, walking stick, shoes). 'trade_in' on a rarity is how many of one gift swap for the next rarity up from the same table (legendaries can't be traded). Gifts described as placeholders are for Joe to rename. A table with 'holiday' belongs to a holiday (data/holidays.json): its pet's table, or 'any' for the 'Holiday' table of presents for opening the app on the day (all legendary, so it breaks the rarity rule on purpose). Holiday tables don't count towards finding every gift for the Moon. 'icon' shows on a table's achievement when it has no 'animal'.
